height.description:
The height in pixels.  If we are displaying a subgraph within this vertex, the height of that
subgraph will be used instead.

width.description:
The width in pixels.  If we are displaying a subgraph within this vertex, the width of that
subgraph will be used instead.

style.description: Style information.  For mxgraph, this will be a string like 'shape=ellipse;fillColor=#cce59a'.

styleWithSubgraph.description:
Alternate style information if this vertex contains a subgraph.  If not specified, default to
the value of `style`.  This could be extended to allow different styles for different nesting levels.

name: FlowGraphVisualizeSpec.VertexSpec
